title: THE DAMAGE NUMBER STAYS IN THE HEALTH BAR
why: His orders of 2026-10-12: redo the HUD and keep the critical info (#35), and make it look like a triple A game (#50). The picture review of a fight found the number of health just lost floating out past the end of the health bar, over the frame of belt key 1. It is drawn inside the right end of the health bar now, over the health it names, and still fades out.
now: The damage number sits inside the right end of the health bar instead of over the belt.
